name: Lead intake: qualify with Claude, route, queue drafts for approval

assignments.name: business
assignments.value: Northwind Automation, a small studio that builds AI and workflow automations for businesses

assignments.name: ideal_customer
assignments.value: a company with 10 to 500 people that describes a concrete business process it wants to automate (support, sales operations, finance operations, document handling) and has a budget or timeline

parameters.query: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM leads WHERE lower(email) = $1 AND received_at > now() - interval '30 days'

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'duplicate', message: 'We already have this lead from the last 30 days.' } }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO leads (email, name, company, message, source, fit_score, segment, reasons, route, problems, model)
VALUES ($1, $2, NULLIF($3, ''), $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, $9, $10::jsonb, $11)
RETURNING id, route
INSERT INTO outbox (lead_id, subject, body) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING lead_id, token

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.id, $('Check the model\'s answer').item.json.subject, $('Check the model\'s answer').item.json.body] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'pending_approval', lead_id: $json.lead_id, fit_score: $('Check the model\'s answer').item.json.fit_score, approve_url: 'http://' + $('New lead').item.json.headers.host + '/webhook/approve?id=' + $json.lead_id + '&token=' + $json.token } }}

parameters.query: WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO follow_ups (lead_id, step, due_at) VALUES ($1, 1, now() + interval '2 days'), ($1, 2, now() + interval '7 days') RETURNING id) SELECT count(*)::int AS follow_ups FROM ins

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'nurture', lead_id: $('Save lead').item.json.id, fit_score: $('Check the model\'s answer').item.json.fit_score, follow_ups: $json.follow_ups } }}
={{ { status: 'archived', lead_id: $json.id, fit_score: $('Check the model\'s answer').item.json.fit_score, segment: $('Check the model\'s answer').item.json.segment } }}
={{ { status: 'needs_review', lead_id: $json.id, problems: $('Check the model\'s answer').item.json.problems } }}
